question: If consumption function = 50 + 0.6Y and Investment = 20, then find the equilibrium income.
solution:
The correct answer is __**175**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Consumption Function: **C=50+0.6Y C = 50 + 0.6Y" id="MathJax-Element-1-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">C = 50 + 0.6Y, where 50 50" id="MathJax-Element-2-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">50 50 50 is autonomous consumption and 0.0.6 0.6" id="MathJax-Element-3-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">6 0.6 0.6 is the marginal propensity to consume (**MPC**).
 
• **Investment:** The given investment value is I = 20" id="MathJax-Element-4-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0"> I = 20" id="MathJax-Element-12-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0"> I = 20" id="MathJax-Element-6-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0"> I = 20 I = 20 I = 20 I = 20 I=20 (autonomous and constant).
 
• **Equilibrium Condition:** = C + IY=C+I, meaning total income equals the sum of consumption and investment.
 
• **Calculation:** Solving the equation Y = 50 + 0.6Y + 20Y=50+0.6Y+20 Y = 50 + 0.6Y + 20" id="MathJax-Element-5-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0"> Y=50+0.6Y+20 Y = 50 + 0.6Y + 20 Y=50+0.6Y+20Y = 50 + 0.6Y + 20 , we get Y = 175

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Equilibrium Income Concept:** **Equilibrium **income occurs where total demand (consumption + investment) equals total output or income in an economy.
 
• **Keynesian Model:** **Keynesian economics**, emphasizes the role of** aggregate demand** in determining income and employment levels.
 
• **Real-World Applications:** Understanding equilibrium income helps policymakers predict the impact of fiscal policies, such as government spending or tax changes, on national income.
 
• **Autonomous Components: **Both autonomous consumption and investment are independent of income and represent fixed expenditures regardless of income levels.
 
• 
 
**Economic Multiplier:** Changes in autonomous investment (like **ΔI**) have a multiplied effect on **equilibrium income**, influencing **GDP **growth significantly.
